say:10:1110121007:0.text: What's the problem? <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't worry about him. He's just upset he picked a fight with the wrong person.

say:11:1110121008:0.source_cn: 尽管在我们的氏族里走走看看吧，我得安抚安抚他才行。

say:12:1110121009:0.text: Soren, I don't blame you. You're in charge of our defense, so I understand that you're wary of outsiders.
say:12:1110121009:0.source_cn: 索恩，我并不是在责怪你。你负责守卫部落，警惕外来者是应该的。

say:13:1110121010:0.text: But couldn't you ease up once in a while when you see someone clearly in need?
say:13:1110121010:0.source_cn: 不过面对需要帮助的人，你的态度是不是偶尔也可以正常点？
